The facility linked to this operator record, described as the Verizon Hillsboro, or Tanasbourne, Data Center, is located in Hillsboro, Oregon, a Portland suburb that has become one of the Pacific Northwest's most significant data center hubs, home to major facilities operated by companies including QTS. This research found the Hillsboro Verizon facility referenced primarily in a data center tracking aggregator rather than in a dedicated Verizon owned publication, so its specific capacity, construction history, and current operational status were not independently confirmed from a tier one or tier two source during this research. Verizon has periodically divested legacy data center and colocation assets, including a 3.6 billion dollar sale of 29 data centers to Equinix that closed in 2017, so the current operator of any specific legacy Verizon branded facility should not be assumed without direct confirmation. This record is written based on Verizon Business's well documented status as a major enterprise telecommunications provider, with the Hillsboro facility's specific details flagged as unverified beyond aggregator level sourcing.
